detailed_description: Git Branch Naming Validator checks one branch name in the browser against three built-in prefix conventions: feature/*, bugfix/*, and hotfix/*. It validates lowercase URL-safe characters, no spaces, no trailing slash, the selected prefix, and the selected convention pattern such as feature/add-login-flow. When the input is invalid, it suggests a sanitized branch name and lets you copy the suggestion. A small reference list also shows other common prefixes, but those are informational only. It is a browser-side naming aid, not a Git client or workflow gate.
usage_steps: Select one built-in convention: feature/*, bugfix/*, or hotfix/*
Enter a branch name in the input field
Review the automatic rule checks for lowercase characters, spaces, trailing slash, and prefix
Check whether the branch matches the selected convention pattern
If a suggested name appears, copy it with the Copy button
usage_examples: Check that feature/add-login-flow matches the feature/* convention
Turn Fix Timezone Bug into a lowercase bugfix/fix-timezone-bug suggestion
Spot a trailing slash or whitespace issue before creating a local branch
Use the prefix reference as a reminder while naming a hotfix branch
